[SWS_PHM_00222] Switch Global Supervision Status from kOK to kDE- ACTIVATED
⌈
If the Global Supervision Status is kOK or kFAILED or kEX-
PIRED AND the Elementary Supervision Status of all Alive, Deadline and Logi-
cal Supervisions is kDEACTIVATED, then the Platform Health Management shall
set the Global Supervision Status to kDEACTIVATED and stop measuring Ex-
pired Supervision Time.
⌋

[SWS_PHM_00222] Switch Global Supervision Status from kOK to kDE- ACTIVATED
⌈
If the Global Supervision Status is kOK or kFAILED or kEX-
PIRED AND the Elementary Supervision Status of all Alive, Deadline and Logi-
cal Supervisions is kDEACTIVATED, then the Platform Health Management shall
set the Global Supervision Status to kDEACTIVATED and stop measuring Ex-
pired Supervision Time.
⌋

[SWS_PHM_00222] Switch Global Supervision Status from kOK to kDEACTIVATED
⌈
If the Global Supervision Status is kOK or kFAILED or kEXPIRED AND the
Elementary Supervision Status of all Alive, Deadline and Logical Supervisions
is kDEACTIVATED, then the Platform Health Management shall set the Global
Supervision Status to kDEACTIVATED and stop measuring Expired Supervision
Time.
⌋

[SWS_PHM_00222] Switch Global Supervision Status to kDEACTIVATED
⌈
If the Global Supervision Status is kOK or kFAILED or kEXPIRED AND the
Elementary Supervision Status of all Alive, Deadline and Logical Supervisions
is kDEACTIVATED, then the Platform Health Management shall set the Global
Supervision Status to kDEACTIVATED and stop measuring Expired Supervision
